text:
taylor_sales: Hey team — customer asked if we can do a POC in a heavily locked-down DC. Main asks: transport encryption for sideloaded bundles, image TTL/rotation, signed BOM, and what's realistic for upgrade cadence without touching customer network. Also pricing impact if they need slower cadence and extra signing.

nisha_se: short answer: yes, but a few constraints. we provide S3-style bundle packages (signed) + detached signature. shipping options: offline USB transfer or scp over jumpbox. transport must be validated by their firewall policies.

nisha_se: we sign bundles with ECDSA-ES256 and include a signed manifest (BOM). They can verify with our public key. delta bundles supported but only for consecutive versions (no arbitrary diffs).

oliver_sre: add: if they require HSM-backed signing or want us to provide an HSM-signed artifact, that's an extra ops engagement and upsell (security add-on). cert rotation: default cadence is 90 days for activation certs, but we can extend to 180 for sealed environments with written SOW.

eva_se: upgrade cadence options we typically offer:
- quarterly delta bundles (recommended)
- monthly for high-security customers (higher support/ops fee)
- emergency hotfix pathway (out-of-band signed patch + expedited checksum)
If they want "no network egress" during upgrades we need a signed acceptance of longer RTO and manual rollback steps.

taylor_sales: can you paste example manifest we sign? customer wants to show it to their security reviewer.

nisha_se: sure — example manifest (JSON, trimmed):
```
{
  "bundle_version": "2026.03.01",
  "components": ["runtime:v2.3.1","model-q4_0.bin"],
  "signatures": [{"alg":"ES256","sig":"<base64>"}],
  "bom_sha256": "abc123...",
  "min_compat_version": "2.3.0"
}
```
They verify signature with our pubkey and check bom_sha256.

oliver_sre: ops note: image TTL — we keep delta bundles for 6 months by default, full bundle archives for 18 months. For air-gapped customers we can extend archive to match their retention policy (contracted). Also, if they run their own registry we support OCI-sideload format; we recommend immutability with content-addressable tags.

taylor_sales: firewall/IPs — they asked whether we can give a limited egress IP set for activation checks.

nisha_se: yes — we provide an activation endpoint that only needs to be able to reach our activation service (IP list + port 443). If they cannot open any egress, we support manual offline activation using a signed activation token we generate and they paste into the console.

legal_ops: pricing hook: extended cadences and bespoke signing/HSM work are billable as professional services or an enterprise add-on. Also note we require an acceptance of delayed patching window in the SOW for extended cert rotation intervals.

taylor_sales: ok — customer wants a short one-pager showing: (1) how bundle is verified, (2) upgrade cadence options + costs, (3) manual activation flow. Can someone assemble and drop link here today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

nisha_se: I can draft the one-pager. Will include the manifest example, activation token flow, delta vs full bundle cost delta. ETA ~ 4h.

eva_se: i'll add runbook snippets for emergency rollback and hotfix signing process.

deploy-bot: Packaging checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/offline-poc-packaging-checklist (view-only) :package:

taylor_sales: awesome — once nisha + eva drop the doc i'll send to the customer and loop legal for a simple SOW amendment. thanks all :thumbsup:

nisha_se: dropping follow-up Qs for customer (paste in case sales wants to confirm):
- Do you require HSM-signed bundles or is our ES256 OK?
- Can you allow egress to a /single/ IP for activation? If not, we'll do manual activation.
- Preferred upgrade cadence (monthly/quarterly/emergency-only)?

taylor_sales: will ask and get back.

oliver_sre: FYI if they pick manual activation + 180d cert rotation we need approval from security for extended rotation window.

legal_ops: noted. i'll prepare standard amendment language for extended rotation and PS fees.

taylor_sales: great — thread closed for now, i'll reopen when customer responds.
